_guide: Copy this file to config.json and edit THAT copy. Never commit config.json - it holds your keys.
boot_brain: which brain Jarvis wakes up on. Any name from the 'brains' block below.
brains: the shelf. 'kind' is 'anthropic' (Claude Messages API) or 'openai' (anything that speaks
the OpenAI chat-completions shape: OpenAI/ChatGPT, Gemini's compatible endpoint, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp-server, vLLM).
Add or remove shelf entries freely - the control tags and the badge follow the shelf automatically.
fallback_models: optional sibling ids tried (in order) when the main model 404s or 429s -
free-tier rate buckets are per model, so a crowded flash model has free siblings.
THE FALLBACK CHAIN: when the current brain fails (quota, credits, dead key), Jarvis borrows the
next usable brain - Gemini first, then local Ollama - and says so. The answer still arrives.
Cloud brains: paste your real key over PUT-YOUR-KEY-HERE in config.json, typed in YOUR editor, never in a chat.
With the placeholder still in place, 'switch to <name>' answers one dry line and stays local. By design.
voice: the local cloned voice (VoiceStudio). profile = the profile NAME you cloned in VoiceStudio.
engine/model_id: Windows (NVIDIA) = voxcpm2 / voxcpm2. Mac (Apple Silicon) = mlx-audio / mlx-community/csm-1b-8bit.
cloud_fallback: when VoiceStudio is not open, Jarvis borrows a deep male voice (Gemini 'Charon',
or OpenAI 'onyx') with an agent key you ALREADY pasted below - 0 MB, no install. Set false for
the fully-offline law; then the browser stand-in is the only fallback.
hearing: local Whisper ears. allow_browser_stt=true lets the browser's speech recognition take over
when Whisper is not installed - that one sends audio to the browser maker's cloud. Set false for the fully-offline law.
When Whisper is absent but a Gemini key is pasted, the SERVER ears transcribe with Gemini (one request per
utterance, free tier) - that is how the mic keeps working in Firefox/Zen, which have no built-in ears.
gemini_model: which Gemini id listens when the Whisper weights are not home.
THE DOWNLOAD LAW: nothing big is ever fetched on boot. The browser's ears (Chrome/Edge, free, 0 MB)
are the default. Whisper weights land ONLY when you run: python hear.py download  (~2.1 GB, announced).
notes_dir: where your markdown notes live. captures/ inside it is where 'remember that' notes are born.
arms: the butler's hands. web.fetch / weather / github / files / skills need nothing. files is the
brain's tool blocks ([[TOOL ...]]) - read/write/list/open confined to sir's home shelf and this folder;
config.json, logs/ and .git/ are private and can never be read by the brain. eyes (screen vision)
needs a cloud brain key (it sends the screenshot to THAT brain only). hands (type/click/scroll/open)
needs 'pip install pyautogui' AND pc_control.enabled=true - OFF by default; say 'hands on' after you flip it.
browser needs 'pip install playwright' + 'playwright install chromium'. Every action is logged in logs/arms.log.
